tagline: Finland's design capital where a church is carved into rock, ferries hop to sea fortresses, and sauna is a birthright.
overview: Helsinki sits on a Baltic peninsula wrapped in islands, a compact capital that pairs neoclassical Senate Square with Alvar Aalto's modernist lines and a famous design district.

The city's strangest landmark is carved, not built: Temppeliaukio 'Rock Church' was quarried straight into a granite outcrop, its copper dome ringed by rough stone. The harbour's Market Square sells salmon soup beside the ferry piers, and the Suomenlinna sea fortress sprawls across six islands 15 minutes offshore.

Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Helsinki. Sauna is not optional culture — Finland counts roughly one sauna per two people, and Helsinki's public ones (Löyly, Allas) sit on the waterfront where you plunge into the Baltic between steams.

funFacts.title: A CHURCH IN ROCK
funFacts.text: Temppeliaukio Church was blasted into solid granite in 1969 — world-class acoustics inside.

funFacts.title: SAUNA PER TWO PEOPLE
funFacts.text: Finland has ~3.3 million saunas for 5.5 million people — Helsinki offers public ones on the sea.

funFacts.title: THE WHITE CITY
funFacts.text: Helsinki is nicknamed the White City of the North for its pale neoclassical core.

funFacts.title: A FORTRESS ISLAND
funFacts.text: Suomenlinna, an 18th-century sea fortress on six islands, is UNESCO-listed.

funFacts.title: DESIGN CAPITAL
funFacts.text: Marimekko, Iittala and Alvar Aalto all call Helsinki home — the Design District is walkable.

funFacts.title: KAUPPATORI
funFacts.text: The harbour Market Square sells salmon soup and smoked fish beside the docks.

funFacts.title: WINTER SWIMMING
funFacts.text: Locals cut ice holes for winter dips — then sauna.

funFacts.title: TALLINN IS A FERRY AWAY
funFacts.text: Estonia's capital is 2 hours across the Gulf — locals commute.

funFacts.title: MIDNIGHT SUN SEASON
funFacts.text: June days stretch past 18 hours; December gives you ~5.

funFacts.title: SILENT DISCO STREETS
funFacts.text: Helsinki ranked world's happiest-city lists — the Finnish quiet is part of it.
